verification_note: Kansas City spans Jackson, Clay and Platte counties, so the citywide total is the sum of three official county reports for the March 22, 2011 municipal general election, the decisive round after the February 22, 2011 nonpartisan primary. Platte County statement of votes cast (Total row): James 1997, Burke 4628. Sums: James 38838, Burke 32595. The Clay report was opened through an Internet Archive copy of the Clay County Election Board PDF; the Platte report is undated in its text and is the document Platte County lists as the 2011 Kansas City general election.
